Customer: how do I put myself as podcast host instead of Name 1
Support: 1. In the left sidebar, click Marketing, then Cold Email Agent, and click Email Accounts at the top of the page.
2. Find the account in the table and click on its row to open the settings panel on the right side of the screen.
3. Edit the First Name and Last Name fields to your name.
4. Click the Save button.

All future emails from that inbox will use your name. If you manage multiple inboxes, you'll need to repeat this for each inbox.
